meta.heading: Three quick calls
meta.intro: Each card asks one thing. Press one of the two buttons. A note is optional.

r18-updates.title: Seven routine tool updates are waiting
body: Seven small version bumps to the tools Shiftbook is built with. They change nothing you see, and each one has to pass all the checks before it goes in.
r18-updates.ask: Merge them once their checks pass?
where: Nothing to look at in the app. These are on GitHub as pull requests #49 to #55 (Tauri, Vite, Tokio, uuid and a GitHub step).

r18-desk.title: The Desk opens on your cards, with calmer lines
bullets: It opens on the middle of your cards, not the paper's corner.
Double-click opens an older entry or a ticket's notepad.
Lines stay faint until you point at a card, and follow it while you drag.
r18-desk.ask: Has the Desk felt right since then?
where: Open Shiftbook and unlock it. Go to the **Desk** (press 1).
Check that it opens showing your cards, not an empty corner of the paper.
Double-click an entry from an earlier day: its details should open. Double-click a ticket card: its notepad should open full screen.
Move the mouse over a card: its link lines should light up, and the rest stay faint. Drag the card: the lines should follow it.
Right-click any card: the menu titles should each fit on one line.

r18-recent.title: Rename, put away, line up and the MOP notebook
body: Six things that went in on 26 and 27 October. If you've been using them and nothing's gone wrong, that's a Looks good.
r18-recent.note_hint: Which one isn't working, and what happened
where: **Rename:** on the Desk, right-click an entry → Rename, and type the new name where it sits.
**Put away:** right-click an entry → Put away (off the Desk). It goes into the **Archive** drawer on the Desk, and you can take it back out.

**Line up:** Shift + drag a card and red guide lines help you line it up. To tidy several at once, pick the **Select** tool in the Desk's toolbar, drag around a few cards, then press In a row, In a column or Tidy grid.
**MOP notebook:** press Ctrl+Space and pick **Open the MOP notebook**. Try its tabs, the Numbered / Minimal / Checklist styles and a template. Dragging a MOP .txt file onto Shiftbook copies it in.
**Timesheet codes:** click an entry to open its slide-out and pick a **Timesheet code**, then check it shows on the **Timesheet** view.
**Copy switches:** Settings → Security → **Copy and screenshot protection**.
